name: recommendation-reason-popover
title: Recommendation reason popover
description: Answer why am I seeing this next to a recommendation or ad: the reasons in plain words, and one-step controls to see less of it.
docs: Pass reasons ({ label, detail, kind }) in plain language, most important first, and sponsored ({ by, note }) for an ad: it says so before anything else and names who paid. onLessLikeThis and onHide add real buttons; return a promise and the row spins, then confirms in its own place (We will show you less like this), and if it rejects the row goes back and says why. settingsHref adds the link to your personalisation settings. trigger replaces the small info button, which is named Why am I seeing this? (title changes both). The panel is a non-modal popover, so it works with touch, keyboard and screen readers, and Escape returns focus to the button. On a short screen the panel scrolls inside itself and its close button stays in view. RecommendationReasonPanel is the same content without the popover. labels translates every word.
